title: Implement frontend integration with apply-schema endpoint
description: Integrate the frontend DDL preview and confirmation UI with the backend apply-schema endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend calls apply-schema endpoint after user confirmation
Success is displayed to user on successful DDL execution
Descriptive error is displayed to user on DDL failure

evidence: Commit e820dfca on branch ticket/TASK-063: 'TASK-063: integrate frontend DDL preview with apply-schema endpoint' (3 files changed, +240/-16 lines)
Files modified:

src/App.tsx — Wired up onExecute callback on DdlPreview to close modal and show 'Schema applied successfully' message on successful DDL execution; added ddlApplyError/ddlApplyMessage state and dismiss handler for App-level success/error notifications; DdlPreview receives onClose={handleDdlClose} and onExecute={handleDdlExecute}

src/components/App.test.tsx — Added 'App - apply-schema flow' describe block with 6 integration tests: Export to PostgreSQL button visibility when connected/not connected, full apply-schema flow (connect → Export to PostgreSQL → confirm checkbox → Execute DDL → applyDDL called with confirm=true → success message), descriptive error on DDL failure, no applyDDL call without confirmation, connection config submitted to backend
src/components/DdlPreview.tsx — Fixed handleExecute guard from `!state.ddl` to `state.ddl === null` so empty DDL from empty diagrams (generateDDL returns '') does not block applyDDL calls
